sections.title: Raw source
items: Summary: A module-facing tracker for rapport with a person or settlement.
When: Use when repeated choices change how warm, candid, generous, or guarded an NPC/community becomes.
Not When: Do not make trust the only route to required information; low trust changes tone, cost, and available help.
Question: How does trust change play?
Answer: High trust makes help warmer and clearer. Low trust still lets play continue, but with distance, fewer gifts, or harder social positioning.
Example: Hush Trust changes how locals offer food, directions, and emotional buy-in. Custodian Trust changes how candid and tender the reveal feels.
Aliases: hush trust custodian trust trust track
Source: Official SRD / local quickstart reference. Use private full-rulebook material only at the table.
